title: ContinuousBench: Can Differentially Private Synthetic Text Improve Capabilities?
code_status: [作者评测仓库](https://github.com/plau666/ContinuousBenchEval)；[curation仓库](https://github.com/plau666/ContinuousBenchCuration)。固定评测tree `0f8a521cfef8c3f500ece717b626ad7c9124dee4`；公开仓库未发现LICENSE，不能据此推定代码许可。
priority_reason: Google COLM官方历史源召回，固定原文方法审查；低成本定义核/评测协议，不是近期新首发。

cost_assessment.sections: §3.1–3.2, Appendices C.1–C.3 and author evaluation repository
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: 1B/4B models, rank128 LoRA/full evaluation 10000 steps, DP generation 3000 steps with batch512 and sweeps; full synthesis/privacy/training matrix not reproduced.
cost_assessment.component_boundary: CPU fixed-release Geminon parser and exact-match/capability-gain protocol; News judge remains external, no privacy accountant/proof claim.
cost_assessment.available_resource: Local CPU/Mac or one NVIDIA A100/A30
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，完整实验不复现；审查DONE。

summary: 若benchmark已经被基座模型做得很好，合成数据是否真正传递新知识就难以区分。ContinuousBench定期生成或整理未见知识语料及相应QA，统一训练/evaluator设置，并与未经该语料训练的同一基座比较；关注高重复公共事实的utility，不要求DP模型记住单条私有记录。 `score_geminon` 独立实现固定作者代码的清洗/匹配语义；`capability_gain`要求两臂题目ID、问题、gold与release revision完全一致，基线必须显式给出；`select_validation_checkpoint`拒绝test行。不得把contains与exact混为一谈：Flying and Normal可覆盖Normal and Flying的两类型，但不是相同字符串。无模型调用、HF大下载、DP-SGD或News自动judge。
